title: A7 - execution model toward the final thrust architecture (waves H2-H4, architecture-changing blockers, M16 as scheduler)
objective: optimize for time-to-final-thrust-architecture, not for finishing every analysis

waves.start: drafting now against A5/A6 with interface-dependent values PENDING; short integration update when the current lanes land
after preliminary sizing, before final design freeze

lanes: hall_only vs rf_hall vs ecr_hall under identical conditions

architecture_changing_blockers: 1 Hall-only sustainment at the actual atmospheric feed state, especially low flow and high O2 fraction
2 incremental benefit of RF/ECR after full bus-power accounting (not source efficiency in isolation)
3 Xe/cathode closure: continuous Xe assistance is disallowed and cathode Xe must fit the system mass allocation
everything_else_rule: thermal detail, mounting, compressor refinement, diagnostics, life, software infrastructure proceed in parallel and veto the architecture ONLY if they expose a hard incompatibility
h2_scope: design/preliminary-sizing lanes, NOT architecture-selection lanes; they never predict thrust or efficiency from unadmitted Hall transport closures and never select hall_only / rf_hall / ecr_hall

m16_as_scheduler.applied_at: the integration pass after the four current lanes are verified (fo_a6_integration_refresh)
m16_as_scheduler.blocked_rule: every BLOCKED row points to exactly one blocking evidence/interface item
m16_as_scheduler.purpose: distinguish an immature subsystem from one that actually prevents H-1 or prevents the architecture decision

phase1_is_the_decisive_event.path: common hardware -> S1a characterization -> LOCK-1 -> S1/S1b uncertainty + remount -> LOCK-2 -> hall_only / rf_hall / ecr_hall experiment

mechanical_case_logic.A: Hall-only satisfies sustainment + thrust + full P_bus + stability -> pre-ionizer removed from the flight baseline
mechanical_case_logic.B: Hall-only fails, RF+Hall closes within power/mass/life -> RF contingency becomes necessary hardware
mechanical_case_logic.C: RF does not close but ECR does -> ECR becomes necessary
mechanical_case_logic.NO_VIABLE_CASE: none satisfies the frozen Phase-1 criteria -> never disguised by continuous Xe augmentation or post hoc threshold changes

repository_management.integration_checkpoint: after the four current lanes pass review: integration pass + M16 refresh -> full suite/golden/ci_checks -> checkpoint merge to main (owner-directed), so the next hardware wave does not pile onto the long-lived branch
repository_management.h2_merge_order: H2 drafting runs now in isolated worktrees; H2 deliverables merge after the checkpoint
repository_management.sequence: finish current 4 lanes (+ draft H2-1..H2-7 in parallel) -> integration pass + M16 refresh -> merge checkpoint -> preliminary hardware freeze -> H-1 build/test -> architecture decision

fan_out_rule: whenever a lane enters compute, review, procurement or waiting state, look for independent work that can run alongside it; never wait for one lane to finish before starting work that has no dependency on it
execution_note: the 4-CPU host caps each workflow at 2 concurrent agents; lanes are launched one workflow per lane so that independent lanes are not serialized
